phase-plan.purpose: Rename the editor-side `platform` and `platform data` language to `project data` so the docs-site/Payload authoring model matches what the system actually stores: project-scoped extension records, not a runtime platform layer.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: collection names/slugs where feasible, API route naming, content-app labels/messages, authoring service terminology, and planning/docs references. Out of scope: auth hardening, validation gating, and schema-form replacement.

file.description: Current collection still encodes the old `platform data` label and fixed platform-layer copy.
Normalization, CRUD helpers, export paths, and revision labels still use `platform-data` terminology.
Main browser authoring workspace still surfaces `Platform Data` labels, actions, and notices.
Current route path should move to a `project-data` surface so API naming matches the product language.
Roadmap and related planning docs should clearly separate critical host-repo work from deferred side lanes.

task.description: Rename docs-site/Payload collection, service, and route terminology from `platform-data` to `project-data` while preserving behavior.
Update content-app UI copy, notices, and planning/docs references so the editor consistently talks about `project data` instead of `platform` extensions.

decision.summary: The authoring system stores project-scoped editor extension records, not a reusable runtime platform abstraction, so `project data` is the correct product language.
decision.impact: Future auth/validation/schema-form work can use one vocabulary across Payload collections, API routes, and the browser editor.
